tldr: Venus in Virgo: love is practical, attentive, and expressed through useful care.
body: With Venus in Virgo, affection is shown in details, service, repair, and thoughtful support. Venus is in fall here, so receiving may need practice.
gift: Devotion, discernment, skillful care, and love expressed through consistency.
challenge: Criticism, overfunctioning, and making love something you have to earn by being flawless.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
